title: Implement custom LookAndFeel and industrial dark metal rotary knobs
description:
Create Source/UI/ShredLookAndFeel.h and Source/UI/ShredLookAndFeel.cpp. Implement a custom juce::LookAndFeel_V4 subclass named ShredLookAndFeel providing a dark industrial visual theme (dark metal background, cool desaturated palette, accent glow) and a custom rotary slider renderer (the 'ShredKnob' style) via overridden drawRotarySlider. The knob draws a machined-metal body, tick marks, an indicator line, and a value arc. Also override component colours (label, slider, button) so the whole plugin adopts the theme. This is a pure new-file GUI module: it must NOT reference PluginProcessor, APVTS, or any DSP telemetry. All drawing must happen on the message thread using only the juce::Graphics passed in; do not lock, block, or read from the audio thread.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt (target name, existing Source/UI structure, juce_gui_basics/juce_graphics module usage)
- Source/PluginEditor.h (to learn the plugin's namespace/class naming conventions)
- JUCE/modules/juce_gui_basics/lookandfeel/juce_LookAndFeel_V4.h (base class API; do not modify anything under JUCE/)
acceptance_criteria: Source/UI/ShredLookAndFeel.h and Source/UI/ShredLookAndFeel.cpp exist and declare/define class ShredLookAndFeel deriving from juce::LookAndFeel_V4
ShredLookAndFeel overrides drawRotarySlider to render the custom dark industrial ShredKnob
ShredLookAndFeel.cpp does not reference the audio thread, DSP telemetry, locks, or PluginProcessor
cmake --build build --target ShredBoost_VST3 succeeds after adding these files to the target sources
No file outside this task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify CMakeLists.txt (g.5 owns the CMake integration)
read from or lock the audio thread from GUI code
